gen-gf-grandstander-gf-jaldi: Grandstander is chunky and playful, all one line width. Jaldi follows with tightly brushed, tall-bodied letters and a visibly gaping c, which is where the pair's real strength lies.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Grandstander's lines wind through each letter like spaghetti, spilling out loud and open-handed. And Kdam Thmor Pro holds the other side, with full, rounded bowls that fill the line in a modern sans.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-krona-one: Fat, friendly, and a bit cheeky: Grandstander draws its a without any hairline strokes. But Krona One runs loose and wide, its lowercase as hefty as cast iron capitals, so a long page feels sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-magra: Round and bold, with no swelling anywhere. Grandstander's bowls keep one outline throughout, while Magra's big-bodied plain sans lowercase gives the pair its strongest quality: a sturdy, grown-up weight.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-major-mono-displa: Neon tubes meet chunky cartoon curves. Grandstander sweeps open in its bold heading, and Major Mono Display answers in monospace with wide sidebearings, glowing like glass tubing beneath it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-martian-mono: Grandstander's heavy, open-handed letters take the stage, while Martian Mono follows in code-style monospace with generous curves and far-apart letters. A long passage would read slowly and deliberately.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, in a plain sans that reads crisp and upright. Grandstander's round bowls above it keep their walls smooth, so the two feel tidy yet playful.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mitr: Grandstander makes round letters whose walls are as heavy as its straights, giving the heading a loud and bouncy presence. Mitr then keeps its x-height close to cap height, a compact sans-serif approach that holds text tight.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-momo-trust-displa: Expressive and bold, Grandstander draws strokes with no pinching at the curves, leaving a heading that feels inflated. Momo Trust Display drifts below with a generous x-height, loose and light.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mukta: Zero stroke contrast, all bold swagger. Mukta's tall-bodied small letters in a plain sans make a longer stretch read steady and upright, never cramped, with Grandstander's rounded heading looming above.
